simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַחְשָׁךְ (H4285) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַחְשָׁךְ (machshâk) means darkness ; concretely, a dark place First listed occurrence: Isa 29 15.

definitions.full: H4285. machshak מַחְשַׁךְ noun masculine dark place (poetry) — absolute ׳מ Isa 29:15 ; 42:16 ; מַחְשָׁ֑ךְ Psalm 88:19; plural מַחֲשַׁכִּים Psa 88:7 ; 143:3 = Lam 3:6 construct מַחֲשַׁכֵּי Psa 74:20 ; — dark place: a. = hiding-place אֿרץ׳מח Psa 74:20 . b. dark region , in which men may lose their way Isa 42:16 . c. = grave , or שׁאול Psalm 88:19 (see Che); of dark place of God's wrath (like She' ô l) Psa 88:7 ; compare 143:3 = Lam 3:6 . d. = secret place, secrecy (of plots) Isa 29:15 .
